core_obligations: Build the factorization and prove properness of f'.
Reduce fibre connectedness to affine Noetherian approximations.
Transport open-and-closed decompositions along the limit.
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y proper between algebraic spaces over a scheme S, the theorem produces X -> Y' -> Y with f' proper with geometrically connected fibres, pi integral, f'_*O_X = O_{Y'}, Y' = Spec_Y(f_*O_X) the normalization of Y in X. The retained proof is complete: the chapter's universally-closed factorization (same wave, L16209) gives Y' and all claims except fibre connectedness; separatedness plus finite type of f' upgrade it to proper; connectedness is reduced via flat base change invariance to Y a scheme point, then written out through a Limits-of-Spaces presentation of (X->Y) as a limit of proper finitely presented maps over Noetherian bases with affine stages, the ring maps R_i -> Gamma(X_i) -> R with R = colim R'_i, the induced factorizations through Y'_i = Spec(R'_i), and inverse-limit transport of open-and-closed decompositions of the geometric fibre, finally invoking the Noetherian case (same wave, L16203) to kill the decomposition. Retained author proof at lines 8217-8281.

dedup.scope: Stein factorization with integral middle map and geometrically connected fibres for proper maps of spaces.
